name: Alkimiya SilicaPools uint128 share-supply truncation
summary: SilicaPools minted the full uint256 share quantity as ERC-1155 long and short balances but added only an unchecked uint128 cast of it to the pool's sharesMinted. Minting 2^128+1 shares on a permissionless pool recorded a supply of 1; after ending the pool, two retained short shares redeemed twice the deposited collateral, taking WBTC held for other pools.
notes: The anchor was sent by a generalized MEV bot that copied the attacker's prepared transaction one block ahead; the attacker's own attempt (0xc8875004) reverted. The proceeds went to the bot's payout EOA and no return to Alkimiya was found, so it counts as an unaffiliated exploit.
Every SilicaPools__CollateralizedMint event since deployment was scanned: the anchor is the only mint with shares above 2^127. Later owner changes to bounty and pause settings do not touch the cast.
